title: Ordinary tensor pullback law
statement: Name the ordinary chain tensor square for four categories, their tensor functors, two coefficient realizations, two pullbacks, the inverse-mate isomorphism, and their ordinary tensor maps. This is the equality of the two composites on every pair of objects, with no localization or derived tensor models.

def tensorOrdinaryPullbackLaw
    {K H K' H' : Type*} [Category K] [Category H] [Category K'] [Category H']
    (tY : K × K ⥤ K) (tX : H × H ⥤ H)
    (tY' : K' × K' ⥤ K') (tX' : H' × H' ⥤ H')
    (U : K ⥤ K') (V : H ⥤ H') (A : K ⥤ H) (B : K' ⥤ H')
    (c : U ⋙ B ≅ A ⋙ V)
    (mF : tY ⋙ A ⟶ (A.prod A) ⋙ tX)
    (bY : tY ⋙ U ⟶ (U.prod U) ⋙ tY')
    (bX : tX ⋙ V ⟶ (V.prod V) ⋙ tX')
    (mG : tY' ⋙ B ⟶ (B.prod B) ⋙ tX') : Prop
